C24 and C02 have somewhat similar WHEREAS recitals leading from an agency-related predicate or suitability finding to a short operative act, but those are generic executive-order structures rather than concrete, materially shared drafting. No displayed candidate plausibly served as a reusable template for establishing and describing an official agency seal.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"A pictorial representation of the Wright brothers' first airplane, with pilot, taking off from a launching rail laid on the sand at Kitty Hawk, North Carolina","parent_excerpt":"The world's first powered flight in a craft heavier than air was made by the Wright Brothers on December 17, 1903 at Kitty Hawk, North Carolina.","explanation":"C22 shares unusually specific historical subject matter, but not sufficiently similar language, legal form, or operative machinery to establish a drafting-template relationship."},{"child_excerpt":"AND WHEREAS it appears that such seal is of suitable design and appropriate for establishment as the official seal","parent_excerpt":"AND WHEREAS it appears that it would be in the interest of the national security to make the designation hereinafter described","explanation":"C24 uses a similar 'it appears' recital followed by an operative designation, but this is conventional and not materially distinctive."},{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS the National Advisory Committee for Aeronautics has caused to be made and has recommended that I approve a seal of office","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS it appears that all such lands are suitable for national-forest purposes, and that it would be in the public interest to reserve such lands","explanation":"C02 likewise uses suitability and public-interest findings before an operative order, but the administrative machinery and substantive language are unrelated."}]}
